name: Isolated shunt current sensing (isolated amplifier or delta-sigma modulator)
function: Measures DC current through a low-ohmic shunt with a ±50 mV isolated amplifier (analog to ADC) or a ±50 mV isolated modulator (bitstream to SDFM), with a differential RC input filter.

outputs.name: I_DC
outputs.description: ADC voltage (amplifier variant) or bitstream (modulator variant)

operating_conditions: Primary: 12.5 A x 3 mOhm = 37.5 mV; secondary: 20 A x 1.5 mOhm = 30 mV.

design_calculations.name: Shunt signal
design_calculations.expression: V = I_max * R_shunt <= 50 mV with margin

design_calculations.name: Shunt dissipation
design_calculations.example: 0.47 W and 0.60 W vs 3 W rating

interface_requirements: Lower output voltages raise output current; TI notes a smaller shunt may be needed (§3.3).
pcb_constraints: Kelvin connections from the shunt pads, routed as a tight differential pair to the filter.
Filter at the IC input pins.
validation_notes: Full-scale signal and dissipation recomputed (EC-017, EC-018). Accuracy budget not analysed.
limitations: Shunt self-heating and TCR effects not evaluated.
